name: Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel
positioning: Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan: a hotel in the heart of Brera, steps from Teatro alla Scala, with interiors by Patricia Urquiola in a Rationalist building by Pietro Lingeri and a rooftop terrace with an outdoor pool
best_for: Design lovers who want a base in Brera near La Scala
Travelers who want a rooftop pool and city views in central Milan
Families or small groups wanting a connecting two-bedroom studio

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Brera, just steps from Teatro alla Scala.
It is a two-minute walk to both Teatro alla Scala and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
The hotel is within walking distance of the fashion district and Via Montenapoleone.
The building's exterior is a Rationalist landmark by architect Pietro Lingeri.
Patricia Urquiola designed the hotel's interiors.
The interiors include Cassina and Poliform furniture and locally sourced marble.
The art collection includes pieces by Tim Walker and Carolina Mizrahi alongside local emerging talent.
Each en-suite bathroom is made of locally sourced streaked marble, with sleek black fixtures and Etro products.
Etereo, the sky bar and restaurant, is on the eighth and top floor.
The Two Bedroom Studio connects adjoining guestrooms for up to four guests traveling together.
The Luxury Collection Concierge can arrange a vintage Fiat 500, theatre tickets or a personal shopping experience.

highlights.text: The rooftop terrace has a restaurant, an outdoor pool and city views.

The Brera and Milanese Suites have a separate master bedroom and living room, each opening onto a large terrace with bespoke seating and lush planting; the Milanese Suite's terrace looks across to the Duomo di Milano.
Patricia Urquiola restored the historic 1950s rationalist building by architect Pietro Lingeri.
From Etereo, diners look out to landmarks including the Duomo di Milano, Teatro alla Scala, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and Castello Sforzesco.
The Seasons of Brera walking tours start at the hotel and change with the time of year.

considerations.text: Brera's cobblestone streets can be challenging in high heels.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
